[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic3 = [[Image:Minister Cho's Estate residence.jpg|196px]] | pic3-text = Minister Cho's residence | ingame name=Minister Cho's Estate | page name suffix=explorable area | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=245 }} The sprawling compound of '''Minister Cho's Estate''' encompasses a large part of central [[Shing Jea Island]], taking up most of the land to the north of the central mountain range. The estate grounds have mostly been turned into a zoo of sorts, home to a myriad variety of exotic animals from all over the world of [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. == Getting there == The only entrance is from [[Ran Musu Gardens]]. == Shrines == ; [[Resurrection shrine]]s with a [[statue]]: * [[Lyssa's Muse]] ** Near the center along the northern beach. * [[Melandru's Watcher]] ** West, at the exit into [[Ran Musu Gardens]]. * [[Voice of Grenth]] ** East, near the exit into [[Minister Cho's Estate (outpost)|Minister Cho's Estate]]. == NPCs == === Allies === [[Human]]s * {{w}} 20 [[Canthan Guard]]s (a few to the southwest) === Charmable animals === [[Animal]]s * {{x}} 3 [[Crane]] (near the northern sandy beaches) * {{x}} 3 [[Tiger]] (in the southwestern and northeastern corners) === Foes === [[Afflicted]] * {{w}} 14 (24) [[Afflicted Warrior]] * {{n}} 14 (24) [[Afflicted Necromancer]] * {{me}} 10 (24) [[Afflicted Mesmer]] * {{e}} 10 (24) [[Afflicted Elementalist]] * {{a}} 14 (24) [[Afflicted Assassin]] * {{rt}} 12 (24) [[Afflicted Ritualist]] [[Beast]]s ([[Sickened]]) * {{w}} 5 (23) [[Sickened Bear]] * {{w}} 5 (23) [[Sickened Lynx]] * {{w}} 5 (23) [[Sickened Moa]] * {{w}} 5 (23) [[Sickened Stalker]] * {{w}} 5 (23) [[Sickened Warthog]] * {{w}} 5 (23) [[Sickened Wolf]] [[Demon]]s ([[Oni]]) * {{a}} 9 (23) [[Lesser Oni]] (one is hidden in the northwestern beach; the other is along the path to [[Temku Caverns]]) [[Human]]s (Sickened) * {{w}} 10 (24) [[Sickened Guard (warrior)|Sickened Guard]] * {{w}} 10 (24) [[Sickened Peasant]] * {{r}} 8 (23) [[Sickened Guard (ranger)|Sickened Guard]] * {{e}} 8 (23) [[Sickened Servant]] * {{rt}} 8 (23) [[Sickened Scribe]] == Landmarks == * [[Buk Wing]] * [[Dah Wing]] * [[Dek Wing]] * [[Foh Wing]] * [[Minister Cho's Menagerie]] * [[Temku Caverns]] == Notes == * If [[Rescue at Minister Cho's Estate]] has been completed and [[Memories of Purity]] is not active, all spawns will be replaced by [[Scavenger]] type enemies. It is recommended to activate the quest when vanquishing the area. * These quests affect the spawns in this area: [[Lost Treasure]] and [[Rescue at Minister Cho's Estate]]. * Complete exploration of this area will yield approximately 2.6% to the Canthan [[Cartographer]] title track. *{{Vanquisher|count = 210|low = 183|high = 220}} ** There are no [[boss]]es in this area, so avoid skills that recharge with [[Morale Boost]] (i.e. [[Resurrection Signet]] and [[Sunspear Rebirth Signet]]). ** Since you can only have a party of four, having a [[spirit spammer]] helps. ** There is a chain of islands to the northeast with foes that cannot easily be seen from the beach. Likewise, there are more foes inside the caverns to the southeast. {{Explorable areas in Shing Jea Island}} [[de:Minister Chos Anwesen (Erforschbar)]]
